module: Flowgraph node "Set UI Race Laps" (category repeat_instant, author BeamNG, duration): updates the laps UI app. Inputs: "cur" (nil = clears), "max". Sends 'RaceLapChange' {current, count} and the ui_apps_genericMissionData entry (category raceLaps, order 110); clears with 'RaceLapClear'.
notes: If max is nil, the concatenation causes an error.

work.desc: Sends or clears the lap counter in the UI.
